title: Welcome to Jain World
description: Immerse yourself in a world of royal Indian craftsmanship, timeless family heirlooms, and bespoke modern luxury.

stories.title: The Royal Atelier

stories.title: Bespoke Bridal Journey
stories.description: Experience personal one-on-one bridal consultations, custom fitting, and customized heirloom creations for your auspicious day.
stories.alt: Indian bride adorned with bespoke royal jewellery suite

stories.title: The Solitaire Universe
